fullContentHtml:
Short Information :Bank of India (BOI) has recently published the notification for the recruitment of Apprentice Posts on the official website of BOI. This recruitment has been issued for 400 posts. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official , Online applying process for Bank of India Apprentice Online Form 2026 has Started from 25 December 2025 & the candidates can apply till the 10 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank of India Apprentice Online Form 2026 which has given below.

Bank of India (BOI)

Bank of India Apprentices Recruitment 2026

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 23 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 25 December 2025
  • Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 800/-
  • SC, ST, All Female : Rs. 600/-
  • PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Bank of India Apprentice Bharti 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates have Bachelor Degree in any Stream from any Recognized University in India & must have knowledge of Local Language.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

Bank of India Apprentice Online Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Written Examination

How To Apply Bank of India Apprentices Online Form 2026 

  • Candidates can apply through link https://bankofindia.co.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the BOI before Last Date.
